summary: Cold agent rosters select actual presentation fields without folding heartbeat history

schema.detail: Eleven additive local partial indexes on claims, installed by the existing owner-index preparation path. No replicated or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: Roster response fields and source authority are unchanged. Full generic status/card payloads remain unchanged. Roster and generic cached cards are separated by shape.

downtime.detail: Before starting the daemon on the NEW executable, stop all writers and run that NEW executable's store prepare-indexes --store <existing-store> offline under the directory lifetime fence and SQLite writer reservation. Preparation duration and peak space on a ~50e9-byte store: NOT MEASURED. Skipping preparation moves the synchronous index build into daemon startup and blocks availability until it completes.

manual.detail: Run the NEW executable's store prepare-indexes --store <existing-store> before starting its daemon, offline and fenced; require the schema gate and WAL checkpoint to finish. An older executable does not know these eleven indexes. Preparation duration and space cost: NOT MEASURED. Measure on a backup copy and budget peak disk before rollout; skipping this step builds missing indexes synchronously at startup.

recovery.detail: Rollback returns reads to the history fold but keeps the additive indexes. Older binaries continue maintaining them, retaining extra write and storage cost; rollback does not reclaim that space. Indexes are local and are not replicated.
